watchOut: The $11,000 starting price is not tied to an aircraft class on the page.
name: VistaJet
roleBasis: Its U.S. page says VistaJet US customers get access to "the iconic silver and red fleet of global VistaJet aircraft", sold mainly through memberships (Program, Corporate Program and VJ25).
summary: Fleet-based company that sells memberships and quotes charter from a single starting price.
differentiator: Publishes just one charter figure: prices "are subject to the market rate and start from $11,000 per hour". The main product on the page is membership, not on-demand charter by the hour.
priceNote: The U.S. charter form says "Private jet charter flight prices are subject to the market rate and start from $11,000 per hour". The page does not tie that figure to an aircraft class.
operatorDisclosure: Describes a single-brand fleet, so the aircraft are its own. The pages we read do not describe how charter requests are fulfilled outside that fleet.
bestFor: Buyers weighing a membership on one branded fleet against on-demand charter.
skipIf: You want an hourly rate card by aircraft type.
